spam_reasons.title: Mature content
spam_reasons.select_subheader: You can always disable seeing mature content in your account settings.
spam_reasons.tooltip:
May include nudity, graphic violence, or mature language.

You can always disable seeing mature content in your account settings.

spam_reasons.title: Harmful content
spam_reasons.tooltip: May be threatening, harassing, hateful, terrorist, or other illegal content.

spam_reasons.title: Self-harm or imminent physical harm
spam_reasons.tooltip: May include immediate physical danger, threats of suicide or intentionally injuring oneself. If someone is in immediate danger, call local emergency services.

spam_reasons.title: Copyright or trademark violation
spam_reasons.tooltip: May include someone uploading a copy of your artwork, using your logo or trademark, or using photos of you without permission.

spam_reasons.title: Posting of private information
spam_reasons.tooltip: This includes sharing someone's private or personal information without their consent, such as contact details, home address, or other sensitive data.

spam_reasons.title: Suspicious content, scam, or spam
spam_reasons.tooltip: May include fake profiles, promotional spam, or other irrelevant content.

spam_reasons.title: Misleading or deceptive information
spam_reasons.tooltip: May include content that disseminates misleading or deceptive information that could lead to real-world harm.

spam_reasons.title: Content illegal under local law
spam_reasons.tooltip: If you are unsure, tell us more about your issue in your own words.
